---
name: Feature Request / 功能建议
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for PyiTOL / 为PyiTOL提出新功能或改进建议
labels: enhancement
---

## Is your feature request related to a problem? / 是否与某个问题相关？

A clear description of the problem. E.g., "I'm always frustrated when..."
请描述你遇到的问题。例如："每次我需要...的时候都很不方便"

## Describe the Solution / 描述你想要的解决方案

A clear description of what you want to happen.
请清晰描述你期望的解决方案。

## Alternatives Considered / 备选方案

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
请描述你考虑过的其他替代方案。

## iTOL Template Type (if applicable) / iTOL模板类型（如适用）

If this relates to a specific iTOL template type, please indicate which one.
如果与特定iTOL模板类型有关，请注明是哪一个。

## Additional Context / 补充说明

Add any other context, screenshots, or references about the feature request here.
其他补充信息、截图或参考资料。
